description: Detached outbuilding at rear involving demolition of existing outbuilding/storage and shed.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:139_351139_350139_354139_352139_353139_355Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the residential use of 91 Tynemouth Drive EN1 4LP and shall not be occupied independently as a self-contained unit.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding does not adversely affect the amenity of adjoining residential premises, is not out of keeping with the pattern of surrounding development and is not used for unauthorised purposes, in accordance with Development Plan Policies.
